statement: What is the value of 44/11 + 110/44 + 44/1100 in decimal form? (A) 6.4 (B) 6.504 (C) 6.54 (D) 6.9 (E) 6.94

statement: Yunji added the integers from 1 to 9 but left out one number. Her incorrect sum was a square. Which number was omitted? (A) 5 (B) 6 (C) 7 (D) 8 (E) 9

statement: Aaliyah rolls two standard six-sided dice. Their product is a multiple of 6. Which integer cannot be their sum? (A) 5 (B) 6 (C) 7 (D) 8 (E) 9

statement: Four skating paths P, Q, R, and S are shown. What is their order from shortest to longest? (A) P, Q, R, S (B) P, R, S, Q (C) Q, S, P, R (D) R, P, S, Q (E) R, S, P, Q

key_idea: 设第一缸数量为未知数，用总数建立一次方程。

key_idea: 把 3 的倍数集中放置，比较覆盖它们所需的最少行列数。
